tasks.subject: Task 1: Add LinearSolve dependency and bump compat
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Declare LinearSolve (and test-only IterativeSolvers), raise the Julia floor to 1.10, and bump the package version.

**Files:**
- Modify: Project.toml

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- LinearSolve in [deps] and [compat] ("2")
- IterativeSolvers in [extras], [compat] ("0.9"), and the test target
- julia = "1.10"
- version = "0.4.0"
- resolve + instantiate succeeds

**Verify:** julia --project=. -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.resolve(); Pkg.instantiate(); using ScatteredInterpolation, LinearSolve' -> exits 0

```json:metadata
{"files": ["Project.toml"], "verifyCommand": "julia --project=. -e 'using Pkg; Pkg.resolve(); Pkg.instantiate(); using ScatteredInterpolation, LinearSolve'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["LinearSolve in deps+compat", "IterativeSolvers in extras+compat+test target", "julia=1.10", "version=0.4.0", "resolve+instantiate succeeds"], "modelTier": "mechanical"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Add the LinearSolve solve helpers
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add internal _initsolve, _setb!, and _solve! helpers that wrap a reusable LinearSolve cache and solve vector or matrix right-hand sides.

**Files:**
- Modify: src/ScatteredInterpolation.jl:3 (add LinearSolve to using)
- Modify: src/rbf.jl (helpers above solveForWeights, ~line 270)
- Test: test/rbf.jl (new @testset "Solve helpers")

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- _initsolve(A, nothing) builds a cache whose first _solve! solves A x = b
- _solve!(cache, b::Vector) returns x with A*x approx b
- _solve!(cache, B::Matrix) returns X with A*X approx B (column-loop)
- second _solve! on same cache with different RHS still solves (factorization reuse)

**Verify:** julia --project=. -e 'include("test/runtests.jl")' -> Solve helpers testset passes

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/ScatteredInterpolation.jl", "src/rbf.jl", "test/rbf.jl"], "verifyCommand": "julia --project=. -e 'include(\"test/runtests.jl\")'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["_initsolve builds cache", "vector RHS solves", "matrix RHS column-loop solves", "factorization reuse across RHS"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Route interpolate and solveForWeights through LinearSolve
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add the linsolve kwarg to interpolate and rewrite both solveForWeights methods to use the helpers, keeping default behavior identical.

**Files:**
- Modify: src/rbf.jl:210-214 (interpolate signature), src/rbf.jl:226 (call site), src/rbf.jl:271-293 (both solveForWeights methods)
- Modify: src/ScatteredInterpolation.jl:26 (interpolate docstring)
- Test: test/rbf.jl (existing evaluation tests = default-path regression)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- interpolate(...; linsolve = nothing) accepted and forwarded
- plain-RBF solveForWeights uses _initsolve/_solve!
- generalized-RBF solveForWeights reuses one cacheA for A, solves Schur with default alg
- full existing test suite passes unchanged with default linsolve

**Verify:** julia --project=. -e 'include("test/runtests.jl")' -> all pre-existing testsets pass


tasks.subject: Task 4: Algorithm-contract tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove interpolate works across all four supported algorithms, including the multi-column matrix-RHS case that broke the previous attempt.

**Files:**
- Modify: test/runtests.jl:1 (add using LinearSolve, IterativeSolvers)
- Modify: test/rbf.jl (new @testset "Linear solver algorithms")

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- parametrized over nothing, LUFactorization(), IterativeSolversJL_GMRES(), KrylovJL_GMRES()
- plain RBF (Gaussian) reproduces data for every algorithm
- generalized RBF (GeneralizedPolyharmonic) reproduces a linear field for every algorithm
- multi-column samples (matrix RHS) reproduce each column for every algorithm
- direct solvers use approx; iterative solvers use atol = 1e-6

**Verify:** julia --project=. -e 'include("test/runtests.jl")' -> Linear solver algorithms testset passes

```json:metadata
{"files": ["test/runtests.jl", "test/rbf.jl"], "verifyCommand": "julia --project=. -e 'include(\"test/runtests.jl\")'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["4 algorithms parametrized", "plain RBF reproduces per alg", "generalized reproduces linear field per alg", "multi-column matrix RHS per alg", "per-alg tolerance"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
